description: Verify that the Solicited OfferService Type 1 entry NumberOfOpt1 of the notification is ≥ 1
approach:
[Objective]
This case asserts a single SOME/IP-SD wire-format invariant: Solicited OfferService Type 1 entry NumberOfOpt1 must equal ≥ 1. The harness drives DUT to emit a qualifying notification, captures it, and validates the field byte-precisely.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester drives DUT to emit a notification (typically by completing OfferService prelude or sending a stimulus message).
2. Observation: captured notification's Solicited OfferService Type 1 entry NumberOfOpt1 == ≥ 1   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Solicited OfferService Type 1 entry NumberOfOpt1 on the wire equals ≥ 1.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_num_opt1 — Entry NumberOfOpt1 zero
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a qualifying notification within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted Solicited OfferService Type 1 entry NumberOfOpt1 == ≥ 1 — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying notification within listen window
